principle: stored_identity_tier is kept exactly as recorded by the producer. attribution_assessment is a separate interpretation with its own method. No stored label is overwritten, redated or redistributed.

provider_origin_verified_actor.label_en: Provider origin recorded from an official IP-range match; this branch does not use the Cloudflare predicate under review.
provider_origin_verified_actor.label_fr: Origine fournisseur enregistrée par correspondance avec des plages IP officielles ; cette branche n’utilise pas le prédicat Cloudflare en revue.

spoofed_or_failed_verification.label_en: Declared provider name whose request origin did not match the official registry.
spoofed_or_failed_verification.label_fr: Nom de fournisseur déclaré dont l’origine ne correspondait pas au registre officiel.

network_verified_claimed_actor.label_en: Recorded classification, reliability under review: this label depends on a Cloudflare predicate that also accepts an empty category.
network_verified_claimed_actor.label_fr: Classification enregistrée, fiabilité en cours de revue : ce libellé dépend d’un prédicat Cloudflare qui accepte aussi une catégorie vide.

cloudflare_verified_unattributed.label_en: Recorded classification, reliability under review: no provider identity, and the label depends on the predicate under review.
cloudflare_verified_unattributed.label_fr: Classification enregistrée, fiabilité en cours de revue : aucune identité de fournisseur, et le libellé dépend du prédicat en revue.

synthetic_probe.label_en: Signed synthetic control request of the collector.
synthetic_probe.label_fr: Requête de contrôle synthétique signée du collecteur.

cryptographically_verified_actor.label_en: Tier defined by the producer contract; not produced by classifier 2026-08-24.1.
cryptographically_verified_actor.label_fr: Niveau défini par le contrat du producteur ; non produit par le classificateur 2026-08-24.1.

initiation_provenance.rule: Initiation provenance is never inferred from the actor role, the provider or the identity tier. A provider-origin request may have been triggered by the site operator.
